ConversationItemUpsertedEvent.description: Canonical item update, or a content invalidation with conversation and no item. Receivers fetch the latest page only when they do not hold interaction control. At least one of item or conversation is required; when both exist their conversation routes must agree.

ReaderScope.description: Opaque reader identity supplied only by the trusted Host from authenticated caller context. Preserve existing callerScope identity and baseline; never accept a Remote-selected scope.

ConversationEnumerationRevision.description: Opaque identity of one immutable active or reader-scoped unread enumeration snapshot within one running instance generation. Equal on every page of that enumeration; a new enumeration may get a different identity even when facts are unchanged. Never compare identities across enumerations, with event invalidation identities, activityVersion, Gateway eventCursor, or recent revision.

ConversationUpdatedAfterQuery.description: Inclusive UTC epoch-millisecond updatedAt boundary. Filter the complete source before pagination, then order updatedAt descending with native ID ascending as tie breaker. Missing updatedAt does not match. No recent-feed policy belongs here.

ConversationIdsQuery.description: Request 1..100 distinct native conversation IDs within route. Filter before pagination; enumerate the full requested set across pages in native ID ascending order. Deleted IDs may be omitted; lookup failures must fail the request, never masquerade as deletion. Larger batches are invalid_request. Requires projectFilter.kind=all; other filters are invalid_request.

updatedAfter.description: 查询更新时间不早于该毫秒时间戳的会话。

ids.description: 需要按身份枚举的会话资源清单。

revision.description: Opaque invalidation identity in this ordered event stream, not an enumeration snapshot identity. Never compare with list response.revision or use equality/order to suppress an invalidation; every received event invalidates the affected view.

ConversationActiveChangedEvent.description: Ordered active-set invalidation and current fact, including active=false on exit. revision identifies this invalidation, not any active enumeration snapshot. Events must cover externally observed execution too. Host tracks a local event fence during snapshot construction.

revision.description: Opaque invalidation identity in this ordered event stream, not an enumeration snapshot identity. Never compare with list response.revision or use equality/order to suppress an invalidation; every received event invalidates the affected view.

ConversationUnreadChangedEvent.description: Ordered reader-scoped unread fact/invalidation, including unread=false after markRead. revision identifies this invalidation, not any unread enumeration snapshot. Host must not forward scope or read state to other readers; every activity or markRead event invalidates the affected reader view.

ConversationDeletedEvent.description: Ordered authoritative deletion invalidation. Missing requested IDs are not evidence of deletion unless the Provider established absence. Invalidate affected list/active/unread snapshots.
